description:
FILED s531b (Opus, 2026-11-01) as the KEY of six UNREDUCED rows of baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv (Fable ruling s531 #1).  Their causes read '#1749 probable (the same unpack/pack U family; not isolated)' (112_upgrade.t, the unnamed row) and '#1389 (utf8::downgrade never fails ...) + #1749 (the incremental parser's \u / utf8 rows; not isolated row by row)' (119_incr_parse_utf8.t, five unnamed rows) -- attributions by family, never reduced; neither #1749 nor #1389 names these files.

THE HUNT: run each file alone (`tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows ~/.cpan/build/JSON-PP-4.18-0 t/112_upgrade.t`, t/119_incr_parse_utf8.t), reduce each failing row to a standalone perl-vs-PCL probe, and re-cause it to #1749 / #1389 (when the probe shows that mechanism) or to a new task.  The rows leave or re-cause BY EDIT.

=== HANDED BACK (s532c) === (Opus agent, 2026-11-08) -- NOT STARTED; back to the queue.
Re-measured on main 9c150764 (code ce665621), one-file runs (s532c scratch m0/): t/112_upgrade.t 3 ok / 0 not ok = perl (the baseline holds no 112 rows -- nothing to edit); t/119_incr_parse_utf8.t 21 ok / 3 not ok of 24: row 6 (got '' expected to match "Wide character in subroutine entry"), row 15 (ARRAY(0x2) vs ARRAY(0x3)), row 17 (HASH(0x4) vs HASH(0x5)) -- the same got values as the baseline rows.
WHERE TO START: row 6 is #1389's (utf8::downgrade never fails, so the die never comes) -- confirm by the #1389 emulation (real perl with `*utf8::is_utf8 = sub { 1 }` / a downgrade that never dies) and re-key it to #1389 alone if perl then fails the same row; rows 15 / 17 are is_deeply over the incremental parser's result -- dump both structures (Data::Dumper with Useqq) under perl and PCL to find the differing leaf before naming #1749.

=== RE-KEYED (s536a) === (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) -- rows 6 / 15 / 17 -> #1494 (all three; NOT #1389).
The file's $JSON_TXT is an interpolating heredoc holding `\N{BULLET}` (`use charnames qw< :full >`); PCL leaves the named escape as the 9 characters "N{BULLET}" (dq strings and heredocs alike; `\N{U+263A}` works) -- #1494.  So the text has no wide character at all: row 6 (`utf8->incr_parse($JSON_TXT)` must die "Wide character in subroutine entry") lives, and the double-encoded rows 15 / 17 compare "N{BULLET}" with "\xE2\x80\xA2".  With a REAL wide character PCL dies as perl does (scratch/s536a/p/4182-4.pl), so row 6 is not #1389; rows 10 / 16 / 18 pass only because both sides spell "N{BULLET}".  Probes: scratch/s536a/p/4182-2.pl (the test with a dump), 4182-3.pl (\N{BULLET} in dq / heredoc / <<~).
